headline: ALI STOPS FRAZIER AFTER FOURTEEN SAVAGE ROUNDS
dispatch: MANILA, Oct. 1. Muhammad Ali retained the heavyweight championship when Joe Frazier's corner declined to send its man out for the fifteenth round at the Araneta Coliseum. The brutal contest ended after fourteen rounds, with Frazier badly battered and Ali spent but standing.
answer: Muhammad Ali defeats Joe Frazier in Manila, 1975
